author: agent:claude-code
message: Add vgsquid-jade (Tenstorrent Blackhole p150a, colleagues over the tailnet) and the Tenstorrent module, with the access model the user chose and what nixpkgs 26.05 forced (LTS kernel, tt-smi overlay, no tt-flash). (proposal 01a15db6-6380-7067-a585-c367d85cb8f2, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

name: Tenstorrent
intent: Tenstorrent accelerators on NixOS: the tt-kmd driver and tools through nixpkgs' hardware.tenstorrent, the 1G hugepages the host runtime maps, and fixes for what nixpkgs ships broken.

name: vgsquid-jade
intent: Headless server with a Tenstorrent Blackhole p150a (no GPU), on the same base hardware as vgsquid-azul and vgsquid-onyx, that colleagues log into over the tailnet with their own accounts.

text: Colleagues get their own key-only accounts on vgsquid-jade, reached over a shared tailnet node
why: The user chose per-colleague Linux accounts with SSH keys and no sudo (core.headless.guests: name = [ keys ]), over Tailscale SSH (would need each colleague as a member of the user's tailnet, with access in the tailnet ACL outside this repo) and over one shared account. Colleagues reach the box by having the node shared to them from the Tailscale admin console; Tailscale SSH does not work across a node share, so login is OpenSSH. sshd listens only on the tailnet (core.headless.sshd.tailnetOnly: no firewall port; tailscale0 is trusted). Guests never get a password, so their keys are the only way in; the card's device nodes are 0666 (tt-kmd's udev rule), so no group is needed.

text: Tenstorrent hosts run the LTS kernel; hugepages reserved at boot
why: tt-kmd 2.7.0 (nixpkgs 26.05) fails to build on linuxPackages_latest (Linux 7.3 no longer provides zap_vma_ptes), and builds (cached) on the LTS kernel 6.18, so vgsquid-jade sets core.boot.kernel = "default". 4 x 1G hugepages per Blackhole card (upstream tt-system-tools' hugepages-setup.sh) are reserved on the kernel command line, more reliable than upstream's runtime allocation for 1G pages, and mounted at /dev/hugepages-1G (pagesize=1G, mode 0777) as upstream's mount unit does.

title: nixpkgs 26.05's tt-smi and tt-flash don't build
body: tt-smi 3.0.30 pins tt-tools-common==1.4.28 while nixpkgs has 1.6.0; pythonRelaxDeps doesn't reach it (the relax hook never runs before pythonRuntimeDepsCheckHook in this package), so the module overlays it with dontCheckRuntimeDeps, and `tt-smi --help` / `-v` run cleanly against 1.6.0 (only a pkg_resources deprecation warning). tt-flash 3.6.0 needs pyluwen~=0.8 but nixpkgs has 0.7.11, an API gap rather than a pin, so it is left out; firmware updates go through `uvx tt-flash`. Revisit both when nixpkgs bumps them.
